messages:
alex: quick ping — PR #2749 needs a rebase and two approvals. Hoping to land before Thurs deploy-freeze (UTC 2026-03-19 00:00). CI is flaky on mac-e2e, keeps failing at screenshot upload. Can someone give quick eyes?

sam: can you paste the failing log? I can try a rerun later today.

alex: pasted log:
```
ERROR: Upload failed: connection reset
at tests/visual/upload.test.js:42
```
I suspect a transient infra flake. The PR also adds a tiny routing change that we want behind a canary flag.

maria: I can take a look now. If it's just upload failing we can skip mac-e2e in the immediate rerun to get green on other lanes and land behind the flag.

jin: what's the rebase window? I have a DB migration Thur morning and would rather not have a risky landing right before.

release-manager: short rebase window Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC. If you can land before 22:00 UTC we'll avoid the window; otherwise plan for Friday. Ping me with ETA and I'll hold the queue.

alex: plan: rebase, rerun non-mac lanes now, get quick approvals, and land as canary if non-mac green. Command to rerun (used by eng devs): `./scripts/ci/rerun --pr 2749 --exclude mac-e2e`

ci-bot: CI queued (position 28). Estimated start ~18m.

maria: quick pass — logic looks fine. left one nit on var naming but not blocking.

sam: kicked reruns for linux and windows. skipped mac. linux-integration flaked once but second run passed.

alex: rebase done, force-pushed. Triggered rerun. Link: https://ci.internal/2749

release-manager: if everything is green by 21:30 UTC we can proceed and avoid the rebase window. I will stand by.

maria: approve. :thumbsup:

jin: approve from me as well. Please add a runtime toggle and a short rollback plan (1-2 steps) before merging.

alex: will add the feature flag + rollback notes to the PR description and mark as ready to merge. Thanks.

ci-bot: All required checks passed. Merge queue position 3.

alex: merging now. I'll monitor canary for 30m and report back with any regressions.

release-manager: thanks — if any issues, use /incident and ping me immediately so we can stop rollout.

alex: noted. will update the thread after the canary window.
